conversation.Statement: Hello. This is Officer Myers from the IRS Investigations Unit. Am I speaking with Jordan Evans?
Uh, yes, this is Jordan. Is everything okay?
Mr. Evans, we have noticed discrepancies in your recent federal tax filings, specifically for the past two years. Did you file your taxes yourself or use a preparer?
Um, I used a website to do them myself. Is there a problem with what I submitted?
Our records show an outstanding balance of $3,487 due to misreported income. The IRS takes tax fraud very seriously. Are you aware of this situation?
No, I didn't know there was any issue. I thought everything was fine. I just got my first job last year.
Unfortunately, because of this error, your file has been marked for immediate legal action. This could include a court summons or even an arrest warrant if the matter isn't resolved today.
Wait, an arrest? Are you sure? I didn't mean to do anything wrong!
Yes, Mr. Evans. Non-payment of federal taxes is a federal offense. In addition to arrest, your driver's license and passport may be suspended within 24 hours.
Oh my gosh. I can't have that happen. Is there any way to fix this?
There is a resolution process, but you must act immediately. The IRS allows a one-time settlement to avoid escalation, but it requires payment through an authorized channel.
Okay, what do I need to do? I don't have that much in my bank account.
For urgent settlements, we are currently accepting payments via Apple gift cards. You need to purchase Apple gift cards totaling $3,487 and provide the codes to us for processing.
Apple gift cards? That sounds a little weird for the IRS.
This is a temporary measure while our standard payment system is under maintenance. If you fail to comply, I will have to submit your file for arrest and asset seizure. Do you want to proceed?
I don't want to get in trouble. Where do I buy these cards?

You can purchase Apple gift cards at any supermarket, pharmacy, or electronics store. Get them in $500 denominations if possible. Once you have them, stay on the call and read me the codes on the back.
Alright, can I go to the store now? Should I stay on the phone with you?
Yes, do not hang up. It's important we document your compliance for the IRS records.
Okay, I'm leaving now. This is really stressing me out.
Stay calm and follow my instructions, Mr. Evans. If you cooperate, we can resolve this without further legal consequences.
